thread:
rhea: quick follow-up from the audit: we saw a persistent ~0.15% token overcount across March that matches a short window where the backfill job retried on partial failures. suspect dedupe gap in the new batching glue. need owners for an audit sweep, patch, credits, and signals.

omar: i can take the dedupe patch and add a strict idempotency key check. will open PR with unit tests and a small canary run. ETA Wed (2026-05-06).

asha: i'll lead customer credits and the email template. propose auto-credit <$30 and manual review for >$400. will produce CSV format for finance. ETA Tue EOD (2026-05-05).

kai: i'll own the RC doc + metrics. i'll add a duplicate_count metric and a historical trend dashboard, plus record consumer restart timestamps to correlate. ETA Thu (2026-05-07).

ellie-fin: finance needs a reconciled CSV: invoice_id, account_id, billed_tokens, corrected_tokens, suggested_credit_usd, reason_code. asha tag me when you attach it.

billing-bot: New ticket MET-7015 created: "March backfill partial-retry -> small token overcount: audit & credits" assignees: omar,asha,kai due: 2026-05-12

rhea: quick query to find affected invoices (adjust window as needed):

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_count) as total_tokens, COUNT(*) as rows, MIN(inserted_at) as first_seen, MAX(inserted_at) as last_seen
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE source IN ('backfill-job','metering-consumer') AND inserted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING SUM(token_count) - LAG(SUM(token_count)) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY MIN(inserted_at)) > 1000 OR COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 300;
```

omar: noted. i'll include a dedupe-runbook and a feature-flagged rollout so we can revert if anything odd shows in canary.

asha: ack. drafting CSV + sample email and will attach to MET-7015 in ~2h.

kai: ack. i'll start a historical metric backfill for duplicate_count and add an alert if duplicate rate > 0.2% for 15m.

ellie-fin: ack. i'll validate the CSV and sign-off credits for amounts < $250; escalate larger ones.

ops-bot: Reminder: MET-7015 remediation sync scheduled Fri 09:00.

rhea: action recap: omar - dedupe patch + canary (ETA 2026-05-06); asha - credits CSV + email (ETA 2026-05-05); kai - RC doc + metrics (ETA 2026-05-07); ellie-fin - validation & sign-off (ETA 2026-05-06). Please comment on MET-7015 when you start. Keep customer outreach coordinated through @ellie-fin to avoid duplicates. :handshake:
